phase: Phase 15.1 court repair — release-mode baseline of the frozen real100-v1 court
measured_commit_subject: phase15.2: resident DocumentFieldSession + observe-batch (WIP, tests pending)
tree_state: clean at court start (git rev-parse --short HEAD = 866f489). The 15.2 additions are inert on the cold court path: the observation memo defaults to budget 0 and observe-batch is a separate command the court does not call.

storage_universes_bytes.note: reported separately, never folded (ADR-0027 extended by 15.1). persistent = the field store alone after field-ingest (the standalone .voldoc may be deleted); descriptor = the optional standalone .voldoc; per-document transient = store + descriptor.

common_success_storage.definition: documents where BOTH VOLE field-ingest (ving_rc == 0) and the A1 build (a1_build_rc == 0) succeeded
common_success_storage.note: on the fair population VOLE's persistent footprint is 1.377x SQLite's (larger, not smaller). The whole-population aggregate (2,667,668,262 vs 2,891,784,192) flatters VOLE because VOLE failed to ingest several large documents; it must never be read as a VOLE win.

large_pdf_failures.note: this is the known Phase-14 large-PDF bound (ADR-0041); 15.1 does not change it, only measures it on the release binary

headline_verdicts.all_text_repeat: loss — RAZOR-THIN: the aggregate cell pools tiny documents whose per-op cost is the ~5-7 ms process floor; v median 7 ms vs a1 median 6 ms, so the verdict sits at the noise floor and is not meaningful at the 'all' stratum
headline_verdicts.everything_else: loss to SQLite/FTS; exact reconstruction loses to the source file
headline_verdicts.measurement_stability_caveat: the 'all/text_repeat' aggregate verdict flipped between two release runs purely from ~1 ms median movement at the process floor; by-format / by-size strata are the meaningful units

debug_reference.note: coverage (455/506/508) and exactness (97/98/100) are identical across profiles — they are deterministic. The profile comparison is confounded by the Phase-14 PDF-ingest change (c14e06f predates it), so no clean debug-vs-release attribution is claimed here.

perf_counters: not claimed: `perf` is absent from doc-baseline (strace + /usr/bin/time are present but were not wired into the frozen court); the plan says 'where the lane provides them'
rejected_runs: 2026-10-07-real100-release-baseline-790c4a7 — invalidated (host cargo build/test ran in the dev lane concurrently with the court; large timing outliers on the documents inside the build window and unstable aggregate verdicts); deleted
tuning: none; the corpus and schedule are frozen and nothing was selected or tuned against any measurement

correction.what: the persistent-byte figures here — storage_universes_bytes and common_success_storage.ratio_v_over_a1 = 1.3767 (2,619,707,424 / 1,902,919,680) — were measured with `du -sb`, which on this bind mount is --apparent-size and counts 4096 B per directory inode. The one-file-per-node fs store carries ~2 directories per file, so its du -sb was inflated ~52%; the single-file SQLite .db was not. No number in this receipt is deleted.
correction.corrected: file-bytes-only accounting (sum of regular-file st_size) gives fs/SQLite = 0.906x on the same 95 common-success documents; packed/SQLite = 0.914x and packed/fs = 1.009x from the Phase-16.2 court. Both VOLE backends are at/below SQLite on file bytes.
correction.scope: measurement only; no descriptor, manifest, index or wire byte changed. See the correction campaign's CORRECTION.md and ADR-0049.
